design.selection_objective: Highest validation mean signed return minus costs, subject to coverage/sample/sector requirements; require positive mean net return in at least 3 of 4 development folds.
design.test_policy: Freeze model and threshold before loading final test rows. Do not retune after final-test results. TCS is excluded from the primary aggregate because its recent outcomes were examined in earlier research.

limitations: Fixed current liquid-stock universe has survivorship bias; it is not the entire market.
Historical candles may have later revisions; no point-in-time live publication archive exists.
Costs are illustrative, fills assume next-open execution without delay.
Overlapping raw bars are not independent; scoring thins within stocks and bootstraps whole market dates.
No live-feed/trading APIs were called, and no production signals were changed.
30 minutes is the trained target; 15/60 minutes are secondary outcome checks of the same frozen rule.
